يستحجب (form X)

# يُسْتَحْجَبُ (yustaḥjabu) /jus.taħ.d͡ʒa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# يَسْتَحْجِبَ (yastaḥjiba) /jas.taħ.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
